evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A conceptual distinction asserted as self-evident logic, performing rational-persuasion by framing a category boundary the reader is expected to accept on the force of the contrast alone.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Supplies a reframe that controls the interpretive frame — the facts are arranged so the conclusion follows from the premise, exercising informational control while arguing from the reframe itself.
